title: App Registration Configuration
description: Schema for Azure AD App Registration configuration

values.description: Array of Azure AD App Registration configurations

AppObjectId.description: The object ID of an existing app registration. Use this property to update an existing app.

DisplayName.description: The display name for the app registration. Use this property to create a new app.

LogoInputFile.description: Path to the application logo file (PNG format recommended).

SignInAudience.description: Specifies what Microsoft accounts are supported for the current application. Valid values: AzureADMyOrg (single tenant), AzureADMultipleOrgs (multi-tenant), AzureADandPersonalMicrosoftAccount (multi-tenant with personal accounts), PersonalMicrosoftAccount (personal accounts only).

RedirectUri.description: Specifies the URLs where user tokens are sent for sign-in, or the redirect URIs where OAuth 2.0 authorization codes and access tokens are sent.

EnableAccessTokenIssuance.description: Specifies whether this web application can request an access token using the OAuth 2.0 implicit flow.

EnableIdTokenIssuance.description: Specifies whether this web application can request an ID token using the OAuth 2.0 implicit flow.

HomePageUrl.description: The URL to the application's homepage.

privacyStatementUrl.description: The URL to the application's privacy statement.

termsOfServiceUrl.description: The URL to the application's terms of service statement.

LogoutUrl.description: The URL where the service logs out the user.

Web.description: Web platform configuration including redirect URIs and implicit grant settings.

Id.description: Unique GUID identifier for the app role.

DisplayName.description: Display name for the app role that appears in app assignment and consent experiences.

Description.description: Description of the app role that appears in app assignment and consent experiences.

Value.description: Specifies the value to include in the roles claim in tokens.

AllowedMemberType.description: Specifies whether this app role can be assigned to users and/or applications. Valid values: User, Application, or both.

IsEnabled.description: Determines if the app role is enabled.

AppRole.description: Collection of app roles that an application may declare. These roles can be assigned to users, groups, or service principals.

IdToken.description: Optional claims to be included in ID tokens.

AccessToken.description: Optional claims to be included in access tokens.

Saml2Token.description: Optional claims to be included in SAML2 tokens.

OptionalClaim.description: Configuration for optional claims in ID tokens, access tokens, and SAML2 tokens.

GroupMembershipClaim.description: Configures the groups claim issued in a user or OAuth 2.0 access token that the application expects. Valid values: None, SecurityGroup, All, ApplicationGroup.

items.description: Represents a single app registration configuration. Must contain either AppObjectId (for updates) or DisplayName (for creates).

Name.description: The name of the optional claim.

Essential.description: If the value is true, the claim specified by the client is necessary to ensure a smooth authorization experience.

Source.description: The source of the claim. Can be a predefined directory attribute or an extension attribute.

AdditionalProperties.description: Additional properties of the claim that modify its behavior.
